name: Forget It
source:
Something is waiting at the edge of the forest. A voice beckons through the static, and visions hail from a night you can’t escape. You see fragments – a lookout, a child, the sound of crying –⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠⁠ but the pieces don’t fit.

You play a man convinced he has been chosen to bend destiny, though by what, he cannot say. Guided by an unseen entity, he searches for a way to stop what feels inevitable. But the more he sees, the less he can trust.

[From [url=https://waltitow.itch.io/forget-it]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有什么东西在森林边缘等待着。一个声音在静电中召唤，幻象从你无法逃离的夜晚袭来。你会看到一些碎片——一个瞭望员、一个孩子、哭声——但这些碎片并不合适。

你扮演一个坚信自己被选中改变命运的人，尽管他说不上来是因为什么。在一个看不见的实体的引导下，他寻找一种方法来阻止感觉不可避免的事情。但他看到的越多，他就越不能信任。

[来自[url=https://waltitow.itch.io/forget-it]Itch.io[/url]]
